user.title: Vigie — AIS receiver
user.description: Serial port of the AIS receiver. Prefer a /dev/serial/by-id/… path: it stays the same when USB devices are re-plugged. Vigie listens for up to 5 s to check the settings.

data_description.serial_port: Pick a detected port or type a path.
data_description.baudrate: 38 400 is usual for AIS receivers; some use 4 800. Any other value can be typed.

no_data.title: No data received
no_data.description: The port {serial_port} opened, but nothing arrived within 5 s. Check that the receiver is powered and wired, and that no other integration uses this port. You can save anyway: Vigie keeps listening and the entities stay unavailable until data arrives.

error.cannot_connect: The serial port cannot be opened. Check the path and that no other program uses it.
error.no_data: No NMEA data received within 5 s.
error.wrong_baud: Data arrived but no valid NMEA sentence. The baud rate is probably wrong: try {other_baudrate}.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

data.expiry_class_b: AIS target expiry, Class B and anchored/moored

data_description.update_interval: Entities write their state at most once per interval.
data_description.stale_timeout: A value older than this becomes unavailable.
data_description.expiry_class_a: A Class A target not heard for this long is removed.
data_description.expiry_class_b: Same for Class B targets and for Class A targets at anchor or moored.
data_description.include_own_vdo: Use the transponder's own-ship reports when GPS sentences are missing.
data_description.own_mmsi: Optional, 9 digits. Reports from this MMSI are never shown as traffic. Learned automatically from own-ship reports when left empty.
